pre_existing_failures.reason: Unrelated to this change; assertions expect 'UNCONFIRMED_BREAKOUT' reason code and 'pullback' wording that differ from current daily_shortlist implementation. No daily_shortlist.py changes were made.

ploy_5_self_check.quality_plus_proximity_plus_close_gte_br: PASS — ACTION_REVIEW requires _dv_quality_pass (4 evidence gates) + state READY/CONFIRMED + _dv_action_review_coherent (CONFIRMED close>=pivot & close_confirmed; READY holds above invalidation). NEAR_TRIGGER requires quality pass.
ploy_5_self_check.why_now_safety: N/A — VCP watchlist projection does not emit why_now; lifecycle state is authoritative.
ploy_5_self_check.no_pre_ready_with_null_why_now: N/A — VCP projection has no PRE_READY lane.
ploy_5_self_check.no_cross_lane_duplicate_symbols: PASS — deduplication pass keeps symbol in highest-priority lane (ACTION_REVIEW > NEAR_TRIGGER > BREAKOUT_WATCH).
ploy_5_self_check.lifecycle_consistency: PASS — only states READY/CONFIRMED/NEAR_TRIGGER/BREAKOUT_WATCH are eligible; EXTENDED/FAILED/STALE/NOT_VERIFIED/FORMING are excluded.

residual_risk: Live DB-dependent behavior of load_latest_vcp_run(daily_watchlist=True) not exercised in unit tests; downstream QA must probe :8000 live projection.
Frontend rendering of capped lanes verified by string/contract tests only; browser journey on :3001 served dashboard is downstream QA responsibility per card.
Ranking weights are a first cut (quality/proximity/context/risk-reward/liquidity/recency); real sample review may require tuning.
